subject.title: fix(signal): preserve newlines in debounced messages

question: Should the CI-wide disablement of pnpm dependency verification remain global, or should it be limited to the parallel boundary commands whose automatic installs race?
rationale: pnpm documents false as disabling its pre-script dependency check, while the patch changes the whole workflow and the current guard only checks that the global setting exists; deciding the intended CI invariant is repository-owner policy.

options.title: Scope the bypass to the racing shards
options.body: Apply the setting only where the parallel boundary commands are known to race, preserving pnpm verification for unrelated workflow jobs.

options.title: Retain the workflow-wide bypass
options.body: Keep the global setting only after confirming that every CI job invoking pnpm has an explicit authoritative dependency setup step.

recommendation.title: Scope the bypass to the racing shards
recommendation.body: Apply the setting only where the parallel boundary commands are known to race, preserving pnpm verification for unrelated workflow jobs.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the assigned repository maintainer and authored the CI portion of this branch.
